title: Solomon’s Prayer for Wisdom

questions.question: To whom did Solomon make a marriage alliance?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:1 (ESV): "Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh's daughter..."

questions.question: Where did the people sacrifice before the temple was built?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:2 (ESV): "The people were sacrificing at the high places, however, because no house had yet been built for the name of the LORD..."

questions.question: What did Solomon ask God for at Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:9 (ESV): "Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, that I may discern between good and evil..."

questions.question: What famous judgment did Solomon exhibit wisdom in?
options: Two prostitutes claiming the same baby
questions.correctAnswer: Two prostitutes claiming the same baby
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:16 (ESV): "Then two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him."

questions.question: How did Solomon determine the real mother?
options: He commanded the baby be cut in two
questions.correctAnswer: He commanded the baby be cut in two
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:25 (ESV): "And the king said, 'Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one and half to the other.'"

questions.question: How did God appear to Solomon at Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:5 (ESV): "At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night..."

questions.question: What additional things did God promise Solomon because he didn't ask for them?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:13 (ESV): "I give you also what you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that no other king shall compare with you..."

questions.question: What condition did God place on giving Solomon long life?
options: Walking in God's ways and keeping his statutes
questions.correctAnswer: Walking in God's ways and keeping his statutes
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:14 (ESV): "And if you will walk in my ways, keeping my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days."

questions.question: How many burnt offerings did Solomon offer at Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:4 (ESV): "...Solomon used to offer a thousand burnt offerings on that altar."

questions.question: What was the reaction of Israel to Solomon's judgment?
options: They stood in awe of the king
questions.correctAnswer: They stood in awe of the king
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:28 (ESV): "And all Israel heard of the judgment... and they stood in awe of the king, because they perceived that the wisdom of God was in him..."

questions.question: Who did Solomon say showed great and steadfast love to David?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:6 (ESV): "And Solomon said, 'You have shown great and steadfast love to your servant David my father...'"

questions.question: Solomon described himself as what in his prayer?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:7 (ESV): "...I am but a little child. I do not know how to go out or come in."

questions.question: What happened to the first woman's son?
options: She lay on him and he died
questions.correctAnswer: She lay on him and he died
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:19 (ESV): "And this woman's son died in the night, because she lay on him."

questions.question: Where did Solomon go after waking from his dream?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:15 (ESV): "And Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant..."

questions.question: What offerings did Solomon make in Jerusalem after the dream?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:15 (ESV): "...and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants."

key_verse_text: Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, that I may discern between good and evil, for who is able to govern this your great people? (ESV)
